message.content:
{
  "page_id": "page-01",
  "page_type": "product",
  "page_name": "AI Policy Inspector Dashboard",
  "purpose": "A detailed dashboard interface for uploading and analyzing insurance policy PDFs using AI, displaying risk scores, transparency metrics, and actionable red flags.",
  "navigation_to": ["Product", "Solutions", "Pricing", "Resources", "Login", "Get Started"],
  "color_palette": {
    "background": "#F8F9FC",
    "surface": "#FFFFFF",
    "text_primary": "#1A1D26",
    "text_secondary": "#6B7280",
    "accent": "#2563EB",
    "border": "#E5E7EB"
  },
  "typography": {
    "heading_font": "Inter, sans-serif",
    "body_font": "Inter, sans-serif",
    "heading_size_px": 24,
    "body_size_px": 14,
    "heading_weight": 600,
    "body_weight": 400
  },
  "layout": {
    "max_width_px": 1200,
    "container": "centered",
    "columns": 12,
    "header_present": true,
    "footer_present": true,
    "sidebar_present": false,
    "sections": [
      "Header Navigation",
      "Hero/Upload Area",
      "Analysis Summary Grid (Score + Insights)",
      "Metrics Grid (Highlights, Waiting Periods, Exclusions, Documents)",
      "Red Flags & Fixes Section",
      "Footer"
    ]
  },
  "header": {
    "present": true,
    "logo_text": "InsurIntel AI",
    "nav_items": ["Product", "Solutions", "Pricing", "Resources"],
    "right_side": ["Login", "Get Started"],
    "background_color": "#FFFFFF",
    "sticky": true
  },
  "hero": {
    "present": true,
    "headline": "AI Policy Inspector",
    "subheadline": "Upload any insurance policy PDF for a deep-dive neural analysis of clauses, risks, and hidden terms. Empower your underwriting with precision.",
    "primary_cta": {
      "label": "PDF DOCK",
      "style": "outlined"
    },
    "secondary_cta": {
      "label": "MAX SIZE",
      "style": "ghost"
    }
  },
  "content_sections": [
    {
      "name": "Upload Zone",
      "type": "form",
      "heading": "",
      "subheading": "",
      "items": ["Drop your policy PDF here or click to browse your local files"],
      "layout": "centered"
    },
    {
      "name": "Analysis Overview",
      "type": "content_blocks",
      "heading": "",
      "subheading": "",
      "items": [
        "Transparency Score: 88%",
        "Neural Summary: This Comprehensive General Liability (CGL) policy shows strong alignment with industry benchmarks...",
        "Key Insight: Cyber extension is included in base coverage...",
        "Attention Required: Waiting period for business interruption is 48 hours..."
      ],
      "layout": "grid-2"
    },
    {
      "name": "Detailed Metrics",
      "type": "features_grid",
      "heading": "",
      "subheading": "",
      "items": [
        "Policy Highlights: Full Worldwide Coverage, Prior Acts Included",
        "Waiting Periods: Fact ARO 30Days, General Lib. None",
        "Exclusions: Intentional Misconduct, Nuclear/Biological Risk",
        "Documents: KYC Compliance, Underwriting Report, Medical Annex"
      ],
      "layout": "grid-4"
    },
    {
      "name": "Red Flags",
      "type": "content_blocks",
      "heading": "Neural Red Flags & Fixes",
      "subheading": "",
      "items": [
        "Ambiguous Co-payment Clause - HIGH SEVERITY",
        "Non-Standard Notice Period - COMPLIANCE",
        "Inefficient Subrogation Right - OPTIMIZATION"
      ],
      "layout": "grid-3"
    }
  ],
  "footer": {
    "present": true,
    "columns": ["InsurIntel AI", "Product", "Company", "Resources"],
    "links": [
      "Precision underwriting and neural policy analysis for the modern insurance era.",
      "Policy Inspector, Risk Scoring, API Access",
      "About Us, Careers, Privacy",
      "Documentation, Help Center, Blog"
    ],
    "copyright_text": "© 2024 InsurIntel AI. Precision Underwriting for the Modern Era.",
    "social_icons": [],
    "background_color": "#FFFFFF"
  },
  "forms": [
    {
      "name": "Policy Upload",
      "fields": [
        {
          "label": "Drop Zone",
          "type": "file",
          "placeholder": "Drop your policy PDF here",
          "required": true
        }
      ],
      "submit_button_label": "Browse Files"
    }
  ],
  "buttons": [
    {
      "label": "Get Started",
      "style": "primary",
      "location": "Header Right"
    },
    {
      "label": "Fix This Now",
      "style": "outline",
      "location": "Red Flag Card 1"
    },
    {
      "label": "Apply Statutory Fix",
      "style": "outline",
      "location": "Red Flag Card 2"
    },
    {
      "label": "Optimize Clause",
      "style": "outline",
      "location": "Red Flag Card 3"
    },
    {
      "label": "Download Risk Report",
      "style": "ghost",
      "location": "Section Header"
    }
  ],
  "icons": [
    "Cloud Upload Icon",
    "Sparkles/AI Icon (Neural Analysis Engine)",
    "Target/Circle Chart Icon (Transparency Score)",
    "Document Text Icon (Summary)",
    "Lightbulb Icon (Key Insight)",
    "Alert Circle Icon (Attention Required)",
    "Checkmark Circle Icon (Highlights)",
    "Clock Icon (Waiting Periods)",
    "Ban Circle Icon (Exclusions)",
    "File List Icon (Documents)",
    "Warning Triangle Icon (Red Flags)"
  ],
  "images": [
    "Circular progress chart showing 88% transparency score",
    "Progress bar for Fact ARO waiting period"
  ],
  "animations_interactions": [
    "Drag-and-drop file upload interaction with hover state change on the dashed border box",
    "Hover effects on all cards (slight shadow increase)",
    "Sticky header behavior on scroll"
  ],
  "responsive_cues": [
    "Grid layout shifts from 4 columns to 2 columns to 1 column on smaller screens",
    "Analysis overview grid stacks vertically on mobile",
    "Red flag cards stack into a single column list on mobile"
  ],
  "notes": "The page uses a very clean, 'SaaS-dashboard' aesthetic with lots of white space. The color coding is important: Blue for primary actions/info, Red/Pink for warnings/severity tags. The upload area is the focal point of the upper half."
}
